name: SwitchBot Lock Pro (US)

radios.note: Bluetooth Low Energy to the phone, keypad and SwitchBot Hub. No Wi-Fi in the lock; remote control goes through a hub.

matter.note: SwitchBot says Matter comes from a Hub 2 or Hub Mini Matter Enabled, not the lock itself. We did not tie a CSA listing to this US model.

apple_home.via: SwitchBot Hub 2 / Hub Mini Matter Enabled
apple_home.note: SwitchBot's page says Hub 2 adds iPhone and Siri integration and Hub Mini Matter Enabled adds Apple Home.

google_home.via: SwitchBot Hub 2 / Hub Mini Matter Enabled

alexa.via: SwitchBot Hub 2 / Hub Mini Matter Enabled

smartthings.note: The page lists SmartThings through Hub Mini Matter Enabled.

home_assistant.note: The page lists Home Assistant through Hub Mini Matter Enabled.

hubRequired.note: A SwitchBot Hub is needed for remote control, Matter and smart-home platforms. Whether the lock works from the app over Bluetooth without a hub is not stated on the pages we saw.

localControl.note: No SwitchBot source states local-only control.

lockFit.note: Fits over the existing lock and keeps it. SwitchBot's North America compatibility page covers single deadbolts; rim and mortise locks need a support check.

keypad.note: Keypad Touch and Keypad Vision are separate accessories.

power.note: 4 × AA included, up to 9 months. One spec line on the US store page says 3 × 18350; SwitchBot's main Lock Pro page lists only AA. A Dual Power Pack is sold separately.

summary: The SwitchBot Lock Pro reaches Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant only through a SwitchBot hub: Hub 2 or Hub Mini Matter Enabled, with SmartThings and Home Assistant listed for the Mini only. The lock itself is a Bluetooth retrofit that runs on 4 × AA batteries, up to 9 months, and has no keypad unless you add a Keypad Touch or Keypad Vision. This is the non-Matter US model, not the EU Matter Enabled one.
caveats: Remote control, Matter and platform links need a SwitchBot Hub, sold separately.
SmartThings and Home Assistant are listed only through the Hub Mini Matter Enabled.
Rim and mortise locks need a fit check with SwitchBot support; some US installs need a 3D-printed adaptor.
Not the same product as the Lock Pro Matter Enabled sold in the EU.
